title: 2.5.21 Challenges — Optional Stretch
description: Pick one or more of the stretch challenges and implement them in the editor. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a canvas
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), create a canvas of any size.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer on the right and find the Canvas section.

steps.title: Create at least one sprite
steps.instructions: In setup(), create a sprite for your game.
hints: Check the Sprite section of the q5play docs drawer for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: Call background() as the first line of draw() so old frames don't stack up.
hints: Search the q5play docs drawer for background().

steps.title: Implement at least one stretch feature
steps.instructions: Pick a challenge from content.md and implement it — top-3 high-score list, a lose state, or mid-game save and resume.
hints: content.md describes the three stretch ideas. Pick whichever interests you.

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts.

requirements.title: Create at least one sprite
requirements.description: A sprite exists in the sketch.

requirements.title: Implement at least one stretch feature
requirements.description: Your sketch uses at least one of: a top-3 high-score list (removeItem / JSON.parse+getItem), a lose state (gameState = 'lose'), or mid-game save/resume (save(...) call).
